meta.notes: A custom status effect. category harmful shows its name in red and lets milk clear it; color tints its swirling particles. attribute_modifiers makes the holder 15 per cent slower per level, and the change goes when the effect ends. msm:on_tick fires msm_examples:frostbite_chill every 40 ticks (faster at higher levels), which hurts the holder by half a heart of magic damage and shows snowflakes. Its icon is textures/mob_effect/frostbite.png. Custom effects need the Fabric mod jar export.
